events.title: Thank you for playing the Demo!
events.summary: Hello all,As Next Fest comes to a close, we wanted to extend our gratitude to everyone that played our demo. This is our first project and it has been very much a learning experience. I strongly believe that the challenges we have faced set us up for future success. With release less than a week away, we are just tightening a few screws but are overall proud of the final product.C.O.R.E. certainly does not approve of this message, but may it be defeated swiftly and overwhelmingly! Drake

events.title: QoL Quick Fixes
events.summary: Hello all,I wanted to provide a quick update on some feedback we have received on the demo. - You can now end the level with the Enter key once you have earned enough Silly. - The sound you hear upon making a mistake will change depending on if you have lost health or not. - It is now clearer when you have earned enough silly to end the level early. Thank you everyone!

events.title: Next Fest and Steam Demo
events.summary: Hello all,Oh, how the time flies. We have just under two months before Silly Typing Game is released, and we are approaching a good place for the initial build. If you haven't already, be sure to try the Demo here on Steam and let us know what you think. Balancing a game like this has proven to be quite a fun challenge, but we know it's not perfect. events.title: Release Date Update
events.summary: Hello all,We have decided to delay Silly Typing Game until November 29th. As this is our first game, we want to ensure that it is in great shape before we ship. We will continue to provide updates along the way, and we thank you for your understanding!-Drake

events.title: Silly Typing Game Announcement
events.summary: Hello all, Drake here!I’m the solo dev at Sunfire Games. Silly Typing Game is a typing game I’d be happy for my own son to play: short sessions, clear feedback, and real keyboard practice. At its core it’s simple on purpose: reinforce what you’re good at, then loop back to what’s hard until it sticks.At launch I’m targeting 25+ word packs, with more added regularly after release so the vocabulary keeps growing.
